annotations.title: Diff two versions of a North Carolina (NC) statute

description:
Word-level diff of a North Carolina (NC) statute section between two versions.

`mode="pending"` compares the text in force against an enacted-but-not-yet-effective
variant — use this for "what will change on 1 October". `mode="observed"` compares
versions this database has actually recorded, optionally between two dates.

CANNOT show text from before the ingest's first observation: observed history begins
then, so most sections have only one version and return diff: null. For earlier change
dates use amendment_history; for pending text use pending_changes.
name: diff_statute
title: Diff two versions of a North Carolina (NC) statute
